associations.rationale: This type family constructs the candidate modules V_i, but its displayed formal type alone does not state their action, simplicity, dimension, classification, or pairwise nonisomorphism.
The equality states the action clause, but it does not by itself state the complete classification, dimension, simplicity, and pairwise-nonisomorphism claim.
The existential equivalence states the exhaustiveness clause, but it does not by itself state the complete action, dimension, simplicity, and pairwise-nonisomorphism claim.
The finrank equality states the dimension clause, but it does not by itself state the complete action, classification, simplicity, and pairwise-nonisomorphism claim.
The instance-valued statement establishes the simplicity clause, but it does not by itself state the complete action, dimension, classification, and pairwise-nonisomorphism claim.
The negated equivalence states the pairwise-nonisomorphism clause, but it does not by itself state the complete action, dimension, simplicity, and classification claim.
